notes: 5x6 grid/ladder sheet: five vertical columns C1 x~50-82, C2 x~211-241, C3 x~390-400, C4 x~640-670, C5 x~845-878, crossed by six horizontal rails R0 y~76 (top), R1 y~205-237, R2 y~378-387, R3 y~550-562, R4 y~743-745, R5 y~866-900 (bottom). The drafter's convention is unusually clean: every intended connection carries a fat solder blob (dot score 2.2-3.7, ~3x stroke width in both axes) and every intended non-connection is drawn as a semicircular hop in the vertical wire (S10, S11, S12, S22, S23, S34, S36, S43 - all verified in the 5x crops, the vertical bulges left around the horizontal). 14 components, 7 nets. NET MAP. n2 = top rail R0 plus the upper part of C2/C3/C4: the 1uH inductor top (50,91), the 5uH inductor top (210,259) reached by C2 hopping R1 at S10, the 10uH inductor top (391,424) reached by C3 hopping R1 and R2 (S11, S22), the 50uH inductor top (644,600) reached by C4 hopping R1, R2 and R3 (S12, S23, S34), and the V-AC 3V top (888,114); dots at S1 (211,77), S0 (393,76), S2 (635,77). n1 = rail R1: the 1uH bottom / 5uF top node on C1 (dot S9 at (59,208)) run right, hopping C2, C3, C4, to the V-AC bottom / I-AC top node on C5 (dot S14 at (870,237)). n4 = rail R2: the 5uH bottom / 10uF top node on C2 (dot S21 at (214,378)), hopping C3 and C4, to the I-AC bottom / V-DC 5V top node on C5 (dot S24 at (861,387)). n5 = the C3 segment between the 10uH bottom (392,494) and the 50uF top (392,625), which hops rail R3 at S36. n6 = the C4 segment between the 50uH bottom (659,684) and the 100uF top (668,798), which hops rail R4 at S43. n3 = the bottom rail R5 from the 5uF bottom at the left corner (82,866) rightwards, plus the C2 wire that comes down from rail R3 (dot S49 at (241,866)) so R3 is part of this net too: 5uF bottom, 10uF bottom (226,474), V-DC 5V bottom and I-DC 10A top (rail R3, dots S35 at (224,562) and S33 at (849,551)), 100uF bottom (dot S51 at (670,897)) and the V-DC 15V bottom at the right corner (845,900). 0 = rail R4 plus the C3 wire below the 50uF capacitor and the GND symbol: 50uF bottom (397,675), dot S44 at (396,745) where rail R4 starts, rail R4 running right (hopping C4 at S43) to the I-DC bottom / V-DC 15V top node on C5 (dot S45 at (831,744)), and the C3 wire continuing down past the bottom rail at (399,886) to the GND symbol (400,916). JUDGEMENT CALL - S50 (399,886), the only place I departed from the ink. Every other site in this sheet is unambiguous: 13 fat dots read as junctions, 8 hops read as crossings. At S50 the C3 wire (which carries rail R4 down to the GND symbol) crosses the bottom rail, and the pixels there (inkmap at 399,886) show a blob about 11 rows x 17 px against a 4 px stroke, i.e. a solder dot comparable to the dots at S51 (670,897) and S44. Read literally as a junction it makes R4 = R5, which puts BOTH terminals of the 15V source #12 on net 0 (ERC: voltage source short-circuited) and both terminals of the 10A source #8 on net 0 as well. I checked every other link in that loop before touching this one: the C3 wire between S44 and S50 is continuous ink (inkmap at 397,815), the bottom rail is continuous from x=82 to x=845, S44 and S45 are deg-3 T-ends of rail R4 with fat dots (a rail that ended on a column without connecting would be a dangling wire), and S49 is a deg-3 T where C2 ends on the bottom rail - so S50, the only deg-4 site in that loop, is the only place where a crossing reading is geometrically coherent. Following the brief's first rule (a reading that short-circuits a voltage source is wrong), I read S50 as a crossing: the bottom rail passes through, and the C3 wire carries rail R4 down to the GND symbol. The consequence of the other reading is exactly one merge - net 0 and net n3 would become a single 10-terminal net and #8 and #12 would each be shorted across it; nothing else in the netlist changes. With the crossing reading every rail has an electrical purpose and the resulting netlist is non-degenerate (R4 = the ground node carrying the 50uF bottom, the 10A bottom, the 15V top and GND). Flagging this as the one place an auditor should look. Non-critical sites S5 (82,135), S16, S28, S30, S39, S41, S47 are label ink brushing a symbol and were left at the tracer default. All two-terminal parts keep the default terminal order (unscored). No class looks wrong: 4 inductors (1uH, 5uH, 10uH, 50uH), 4 capacitors (5uF, 10uF, 50uF, 100uF), V-AC 3V/1kHz, I-AC 5A/1kHz, V-DC 5V, I-DC 10A, V-DC 15V, one GND.
